batch_policy.action: move the final index of the penultimate batch to the front of the final singleton batch
batch_policy.new_execution: recompute BOTH methods for all 360 datasets into a fresh namespace; never transplant old PASS records
batch_policy.prior_failure_policy: v6 records remain immutable and disclosed; v7 is a distinct amended execution
batch_policy.scope: all 360 datasets under the same rule; no per-dataset rescue
batch_policy.trigger: training only, final batch contains exactly one sample

rewrite_policy: Scientific comparator results are frozen. Never overwrite/delete/rerun in place. Any recovery or extension requires a new versioned stage.
